title: AI assistants for lawyers
why: AI can speed up first drafts, summaries and clause comparisons — if used within professional and confidentiality rules.
what_is_different: Legal use demands confidentiality (client data only in approved tools), verification of every authority (AI can invent cases), and jurisdiction-specific accuracy. AI drafts are starting points, never advice.

extra_modules.title: Clause review and comparison
extra_modules.outcome: You can: compare a draft against your preferred positions
topics: redline suggestions to review in Word
extra_modules.practice: Compare an NDA against a firm checklist and list deviations

extra_modules.title: Firm policy and approved tools
extra_modules.outcome: You can: set up compliant AI use for a team
extra_modules.practice: Draft an AI-use policy for a small practice

starter_project: Create a reusable, verified workflow for first-pass NDA review: approved tool, prompt playbook, checklist, and a human sign-off step.
pitfalls: Pasting client-confidential data into unapproved tools
Treating AI output as legal advice

expert_validation.note: AI-drafted outline; to be validated by a practitioner and an educator in this field.
